newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Prudential on US Surgical.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Prudential on US Surgical.

text.p: -- Prudential Securities analyst Charlene Lu said she reiterated her buy on U.S. Surgical Corp, saying an upcoming meeting of surgeons would be a "major catalyst" for the stock.

-- She said the company would be presenting details at next week's American College of Surgeons convention in San Francisco of a device that uses laser to improve blood supply to the heart, a minimally invasive bypass kit, and a smaller-sized version of its ABBI breast biopsy system.
-- Prudential this week made U.S. Surgical its "single best idea" among medical device stocks.
-- The shares ended up 1/2 at 44-1/8 after hitting a 52-week high of 45-7/8.
